devtools.template: Attach browser devtools to the web app via the chrome-devtools MCP. Desktop: launch Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 and point chrome-devtools at http://localhost:9222. Phone (Android): enable USB debugging, run `adb reverse tcp:9222 tcp:9222`, open the app in Chrome on the phone, then use the chrome-devtools tools to inspect the live page (viewport, console, elements, network).
devtools.description: Open devtools on the app, including on a phone via CDP

fix.template: Diagnose and fix the most recent CLI error. Read ~/.opencode-autofix-log.json, identify root cause, and apply the fix.
fix.description: Diagnose and fix the most recent CLI error

fix-tests.template: Read ~/.opencode-test-failures.json and ~/.opencode-autofix-log.json. For each test failure, find the test file and source file, identify the root cause, and apply minimal fixes. Verify each fix by re-running the failing test.
fix-tests.description: Diagnose and fix the most recent test failures

ui-fix.template: Read the UI error log at ~/.opencode-ui-error-log.json and the live backend errors at http://localhost:8000/errors/recent. Diagnose the most recent frontend error, identify the file and root cause, and apply a fix.
ui-fix.description: Diagnose and fix the most recent frontend UI error

doc-aware.template: Load relevant docs for the given task area (frontend, backend, core, sdk, infra, cli). Read the doc map in .opencode/agents/doc-aware-engineer.md, then load the docs.
doc-aware.description: Load relevant project docs before making changes

error-fixer.description: Diagnoses and fixes errors detected in CLI logs.

doc-aware-engineer.description: Reads project manuals and docs before making changes.

ui-error-fixer.description: Diagnoses and fixes frontend UI errors.
